findings.root_cause: Public launchers did not invoke the environment policy and loopback classification relied on literal host strings.
findings.fix: Run one fail-closed policy before every public child spawn and normalize loopback-equivalent host syntax deterministically.
findings.new_regression_tests: Seven public commands by fifteen unsafe configurations, with exit, no-listener, and port-rebind assertions.

findings.root_cause: Accepted 120-digit operands were calculated in an 80-significant-digit context without result-domain validation.
findings.fix: Use 240-digit exact working precision, validate public results at 120 digits, and return exact-or-DECIMAL_RESULT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
findings.new_regression_tests: Boundary examples plus fast-check comparison to an independent BigInt coefficient/scale oracle.

findings.root_cause: Office authority was structurally copyable, stale at decision time, and incompletely bound to proposal representation.
findings.fix: Use private issued-context identity, re-resolve all current authority, and bind the full immutable proposal decision scope.
findings.new_regression_tests: Copy/substitution attacks, revocation/reassignment/suspension/revision attacks, and proposal-representation substitution.

findings.root_cause: Canonical normalization invoked duck-typed methods, property accessors, and Proxy reflection traps.
findings.fix: Allow only explicit domain adapters, inspect inert descriptors, and reject native Proxy identity before reflection.
findings.new_regression_tests: Methods, getters/setters, live/revoked Proxy with zero traps, hidden/symbol state, and reconstruction ordering.

findings.root_cause: Regex-only enforcement missed module forms, unary conversion, and aliased numeric coercion.
findings.fix: Parse TypeScript AST module and coercion forms, including assignments, computed/bound aliases, destructuring, and Reflect calls.
findings.new_regression_tests: Real scanner CLI fixtures for dynamic/nonliteral modules, unary plus, and computed/bound/reflective Number aliases.

findings.root_cause: External Supabase UUID subjects were forced through an incompatible uppercase domain identifier type.
findings.fix: Introduce a UUID-safe AuthSubject brand, canonical case normalization, exact profile whitelist, and canonical token/profile equality.
findings.new_regression_tests: Realistic UUID, uppercase normalization, malformed/revoked subject, mismatch, and portable-authority-field attacks.

findings.root_cause: Migration provenance was accepted as caller metadata without verifying artifact bytes at the named Git object, and ordinary Git lookup honored replace refs.
findings.fix: Use the truthful source commit, verify commit/path/hash with replace refs disabled, and record only verified provenance in rehearsal.
findings.new_regression_tests: Nonexistent/absent/mismatched/unverified provenance plus a disposable Git replace-ref attack.
findings.focused_test_result: PASS 14/14; validation PASS; PGlite clean/existing PASS
